policy: Three missing outer-frame fits, current native source and pinned historical frame poses; eight calibration and twelve reserved names each.
Reserved cohorts have been reused and are development validation, not fresh tests.
Old M21 side windows cross the black art keyline. Fixed eroded rail interiors replace them for both source and reference before fitting; windows do not vary by scan or fit result.
Native response refinement uses calibration targets and renderer-only residuals; no target values from reserved cards.
Paper, black-level and stock fits remain separate. No runtime profiles changed by this study.
Component gates are not whole-card scores or proof that an unchanged default is validated across the set.
